Domaine des Trois Chênes: 18ha (11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc), ~62,000 bottles/year; 2024 hail cut output to 48,000. Organic since 2019; biodynamic certification possible 2026. Exports 41%, mainly Belgium and Japan — Japan requires sulphites under 60mg/L.

Past failures: a 2022 tank 4 controller fault cost €11,000; controllers are now calibrated pre-harvest and tank 4 has a second probe. A 2023 labelling error recalled 900 bottles; label proofs need two signatures.

Rules: no irrigation on western plots; harvest dates set by three mornings of sugar/acidity readings; tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours.

Open: lighter bottles (awaiting importer approval, no cost comparison); eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided (54-year-old vines, yields down 30%).
